request.promptText: Generate a single female voice speaking exactly this transcript, with every word intact: "One opponent left." Match the female speaking voice timbre, register, accent and precise formal delivery of @Audio1. Brisk, professional 1950s military flight-controller announcement, clear and authoritative without shouting. Clearly articulate ONE OPPONENT LEFT. Start speaking immediately and finish promptly, roughly one and a half to two seconds. Use the reference only for vocal characteristics; do not say the reference words about transport. Dry clean isolated voice with steady volume. No music, machinery, drone, static, echo, reverb or loudspeaker effects.

direction: Same reference voice as the illegal-exit and arena speed announcements.
processing: Mono to stereo; 320 Hz highpass, 4300 Hz lowpass, +3 dB at 1600 Hz, 3:1 compression, short reflections at 37/73/113/173/251 ms, subtle 240/480 ms echo; loudness matched to the illegal-exit clip (-21.4 LUFS) with peak limiter; trailing silence trimmed; no time stretching.
playback: Local living rider (solo player or assigned MP seat) when its living in-arena opponents first drop to one in a round.
useConstraints: Generated using a TRON (1982) film voice reference; underlying rights remain with respective owners.
